read.thesis: Q4 revenue grew 7% LC above guided range, but management flagged lower pricing in many areas and FY27 guide of 3-6% LC (2-2.5% inorganic) implies low organic growth amid intense competition.

utilisation.quote: Just looking at utilization rates, it looked like they were steady quarter-over-quarter and year-over-year.

capex.quote: property and equipment additions to be approximately $900 million

triggers.label: Lower pricing in Q4
triggers.quote: in Q4, we saw lower pricing in many areas of our business

triggers.label: FY27 organic growth ~1-4% implied
triggers.quote: we expect our revenue to be in the range of 3% to 6% growth in local currency over fiscal '26. This year, we expect an inorganic contribution of 2% to 2.5%.

guidance.quote: we expect our revenue to be in the range of 3% to 6% growth in local currency over fiscal '26
we expect fiscal year '27 to be 15.9% to 16.1%, a 10 to 30 basis point expansion
We expect our full year diluted earnings per share for fiscal '27 to be in the range of $14.39 to $14.81
free cash flow to be in the range of $11 billion to $11.8 billion
$5.5 billion in share repurchases, which exceed issuances
we currently expect to deploy another approximately $5 billion in acquisitions in fiscal '27
reflects an estimated 2% to 6% growth in local currency

red_flags.label: Lower pricing in Q4 across many areas
red_flags.quote: in Q4, we saw lower pricing in many areas of our business

red_flags.label: Middle East headwind worsened in Q4
red_flags.quote: the direct impact of the Middle East continued to be a headwind and in fact, worsened in Q4

red_flags.label: DSO rose to 50 days
red_flags.quote: Days services outstanding were 50 days compared to 48 days last quarter and 47 days in the fourth quarter of last year.

evasions.quote: It's going to continue to be lumpy, which is why we don't guide to bookings.
the impact has been steady. So -- and we're offsetting as we have in the past with new kinds of work
